description: Yesterday's day-trade state map: per-name intraday lights grid (price/RSI/MACD x 5m-1D), GO, FUEL vs anchor ETF, entry-window state and ROOM for 3 names plus 2 per cohort, with the cohort anchors and the reading guide. Day states decay in minutes, so this delayed tier is a schema/shape preview, not a trading input. Free sample: 3 names plus 2 per cohort, one market day delayed.
name: get_day_board
